name: 30° Dive CCIP
summary: Roll in from 7,000 ft, 30° dive, pickle at 4,000 ft
procedure: DSMS: profile selected, CCIP, correct release settings
Roll in, pipper short of the target and let it walk up
Pickle at release altitude — 3.5 G recovery, jink on egress

name: 45° Dive CCIP
summary: Steep dive from 10,000 ft, pickle at 5,500 ft
procedure: DSMS: profile selected, CCIP
Steep roll-in — watch speed, throttle back
Pickle at release altitude — 4 G recovery

name: Gun 15°
summary: Shallow gun pass: open fire around 1.5 nm, cease by 1,500 ft
procedure: GUNS: PAC on, CCIP gun cross
Roll in, put the gun cross on the target, one-second bursts
Cease fire at 1,500 ft and pull — never press a gun pass

name: Rockets 20°
summary: Rocket pass from 4,000 ft, fire at 2,500 ft
procedure: DSMS: rocket profile, CCIP
Roll in, pipper on the target
Fire at release altitude, pull — rockets need a steady pipper

name: Level CCRP 12k (LGB)
summary: Straight and level, TGP lase, CCRP release
procedure: DSMS: LGB profile, CCRP; TGP SOI, point track the target, laser code set
Wings level, pickle and hold — release at the cue
Lase from 10 s before impact until impact

name: Level CCRP 15k (JDAM)
summary: Straight and level inside the range cue, CCRP release
procedure: DSMS: JDAM profile, CCRP; SPI on the target
Inside the range cue: wings level, pickle and hold until release

name: Maverick 8k level
summary: Medium altitude, lock and fire inside range
procedure: Maverick page SOI, seeker slaved to the SPI or slewed
Lock, confirm in range and a good track
Fire — keep the nose on until launch

name: Laydown 500 ft (HD)
summary: Fast and low, CCRP release of high-drag bombs
procedure: High-drag / retarded bombs only
DSMS: CCRP, SPI on the target
Level at 500 ft, pickle and hold through release
